sources.snippet: Dataset-agnostic pipeline that turns raw multi-channel sensor recordings into language-model-ready captions. The current reference implementation targets the MyHeartCounts (MHC) wearable dataset at daily and weekly resolution.

sources.title: TimeCap: A Scalable Open-Source Pipeline for Captioning Wearable Health ...
sources.snippet: TIMECAP addresses both by replacing language-model generation with deterministic extractors operating directly on the signal, and by exposing a channel-schema abstraction so that the pipeline applies to any multivariate time-series data through channel definitions alone, rather than pipeline redesign. Figure 1 provides a visual overview.
